content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) set-up in Etawah district, under the District Programme Officer (जिला कार्यक्रम अधिकारी), Etawah, has invited online applications for direct recruitment of Anganwadi Worker (Anganwadi Worker) on 102 honorarium-based vacant posts. The recruitment follows the framework laid down in Uttar Pradesh Government Order No. 1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025(1917687) dated 17 September 2025. The notification itself was issued on 7 August 2026 and approved by the Chief Development Officer and District Magistrate, Etawah, on 5 August 2026. Register for Job Alerts

content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Important Dates 2026
content_sections.text: The notification specifies the closing date for online applications. An application start date is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 102 vacancies are available - 10 for Chakarnagar, 8 for Takha, 14 for Basrehar, 26 for Maheva, 12 for Bharthana, 13 for Badhpura, 6 for Saifai, 2 for Shahar (City), and 11 for Jaswantnagar. The notification states that the number of vacant posts may increase or decrease, and the decision to recruit, not recruit, or cancel the recruitment rests with the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Eligibility Criteria & Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible for these posts. Minimum educational qualification: Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent. Candidates with higher qualification up to postgraduate level will also be considered; merit will be prepared based on the maximum qualification held. A candidate must be a permanent resident of the ward/Gram Sabha where the vacant post exists. If no eligible candidate is available from that Gram Sabha, a permanent resident of the concerned Nyay Panchayat is considered. For urban (Shahri) posts, the relevant ward number and ward name must be mentioned in the online residence certificate. Only updated residence and caste certificates issued online with digital signature from the Tehsil, and verifiable online, will be accepted. Income certificates must be issued by the competent authority as per UP Government Revenue Department Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj-9-9 dated 30 September 2011 (as amended), and must be online-verifiable. For widows, a death certificate and family register copy issued/attested by the Gram Panchayat Adhikari or concerned Nagar Nikay is valid. For divorced/deserted women, a valid court order is required.

content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age relaxation details for reserved categories are not specified in the notification. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Reservation & Priority Order 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lays down a priority (वरीयता) order for selection within an eligible Gram Sabha/ward, applied in the following sequence: Permanent residents of the same Gram Sabha/ward (urban areas) who are from families living below the poverty line (BPL), including widows and legally divorced/deserted women. If no such candidate is available, widowed/divorced/deserted women from BPL families in the same Gram Sabha/ward. If still unavailable, women from families living above the poverty line in the same Gram Sabha/ward. If no eligible candidate is available in the Gram Sabha under any of the above categories, selection is made category-wise from the concerned Nyay Panchayat. BPL category is determined as per Social Welfare Department (Anubhag-2) Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 (as amended). Applications are accepted only under the category for which a post is reserved; posts under the unreserved category are open to candidates of any category. Reservation for SC, ST, and OBC candidates in Anganwadi Worker and Sahayika appointments follows applicable government orders.

content_sections.heading: Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is merit-based, prepared according to the candidate's educational qualification (from Intermediate up to postgraduate level), subject to the residence requirement and the priority/reservation order described above. A written examination or interview is not mentioned in the notification. The final decision on filling, not filling, or cancelling any post lies with the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Etawah UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official portal: upanganwadibharti.in Fill the online application form carefully with accurate details in the prescribed format. Upload clean, legible, self-attested scanned copies of required documents (residence certificate, caste certificate, income certificate, educational certificates, and category-specific documents such as death certificate/family register or court order, where applicable). Ensure the ward number/name (for urban posts) is correctly mentioned as per the online residence certificate. Submit the application before the last date, 30 August 2026, till midnight. Applications are accepted only through the official departmental website. Offline applications, in any form, are not accepted under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only online applications submitted through upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed timeframe will be accepted; offline applications will not be considered. Documents must be uploaded exactly as declared in the online form; no offline or postal submission of documents is valid. If any error, false, or fabricated information/document is found, the candidature will be rejected. The number of vacant posts may increase or decrease. Filling, not filling, or cancelling the recruitment for these posts rests with the selection committee. Detailed forms, eligibility criteria, and application procedure are also available at the Child Development Project Office of the concerned Development Block, or at the District Programme Officer (Child Development Department) office at Vikas Bhawan, Etawah, on working days.

faq.question: Q1. What is Etawah Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Etawah, to fill 102 vacant, honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakatri posts across nine Child Development Projects in Etawah district, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 102 vacancies in total, distributed across Chakarnagar, Takha, Basrehar, Maheva, Bharthana, Badhpura, Saifai, Shahar (urban), and Jaswantnagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Minimum Intermediate (12th) or equivalent. Merit is prepared based on the highest qualification held, up to postgraduate level.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years and maximum 35 years, calculated as of the cut-off date, 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Only through the official portal, upanganwadibharti.in. Offline applications are not accepted in any form.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Merit-based selection according to educational qualification, subject to residence eligibility (Gram Sabha/ward or Nyay Panchayat) and the BPL/widow/divorced-deserted priority order specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary/honorarium?
faq.answer: The post is honorarium-based; the specific amount is not specified in the notification.
